title: Cultured fish epithelial cells are a source of alarm substance
author: Hintz, Weihing, et al.

steps.title: Collect epithelial cells from fish
steps.instruction: Remove fish from home tanks and place them in approximately 1500 mL of water containing 400 µL oil of cloves solution; induce a light plane of anesthesia, excise epithelial cells with a clean scalpel, and transfer the cells into a 15 mL polypropylene vial containing supplemented PBS.

steps.title: Initial wash and vortex of cells
steps.instruction: All reagents are at room temperature. Vortex the conical vial with the cells for ~15 s at the highest speed (speed 10 on a VWR Mini Vortexer VM3000) to disrupt mucus, then centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min. Discard the supernatant, add 10.0 mL fresh supplemented PBS, and repeat the vortex‑wash cycle two more times. After the final wash, remove as much PBS as possible without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in supplemented Leibovitz's medium
steps.instruction: Prepare supplemented Leibovitz's medium by adding to Leibovitz's L‑15: 20 % fetal bovine serum, 1.5 % penicillin/streptavidin, 1.% Fungizone, 1.5 % kanamycin, and 1.5 % tetracycline. Resuspend the final pellet in 6.0 mL of this medium, vortex, and if scales are visible let the tube stand vertically for 15 s to let them settle. Using a sterile Pasteur pipet, avoid the scales and transfer the cell‑medium suspension to a sterile T25 flask with a vented cap (Corning).

steps.title: Culture cells and store supernatant
steps.instruction: Incubate the T25 flask at room temperature on a clean bench. After 24 h, pellet the cell suspension by centrifugation at 5000 rpm for 5 min. Immediately transfer the supernatant (culture media plus cellular products) into a 15.0 mL polypropylene conical vial and store at –20 °C for later behavioral assays.

steps.title: Final wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Add 10.0 mL supplemented PBS to the cell pellet and vortex for 10 s at maximum speed to resuspend. Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min, discard the supernatant, then add 10.0 mL fresh supplemented PBS and repeat the vortex‑wash cycle two more times. After the final wash, remove as much PBS as possible without disturbing the pellet, then resuspend the cells in 6.0 mL supplemented Leibovitz's medium.

steps.title: Maintain culture and harvest media
steps.instruction: Maintain the primary cell culture, harvesting the supernatant every 24 h for up to a maximum of 5 days.

steps.title: Thaw and warm media for assays
steps.instruction: For behavioral assays, thaw frozen media in conical vials on ice, then warm the vial to room temperature by holding it in your hands just before use.
